values.note: Rate covers 2 people, an RV and one vehicle: off-lake sites (106-168) $85 a day or $510 a week, waterfront sites $95 a day or $570 a week (7th night free). Extra adult (11+) $5 a day, extra vehicle or golf cart $2 a day; visitors pay $5 per person plus $2 per vehicle. Monthly $1,600 (non-waterfront sites only, up to 3 months).

summary: Confirmed on the operator's rates, reservations and policies pages (browser render): $85 off-lake / $95 waterfront full-hookup sites for 2026, 50-amp W/E/S at every site, phone-only booking with a one-night deposit, 3-night holiday minimum, season April 1 - December 1, laundry and general store. Sites are 49 x 85 ft (no rig limit or count stated). Good Sam flag left (derived). Note: dropped the RV Life line (in rating) and the phone-only booking line (in booking).
flags: PRICE GATE: private campground, the family has not stayed here, and the operator's 2026 base rate is $85/night (off-lake full hookup; waterfront $95) (https://www.islandresort.org/rates/), well over the US$50 gate. No Good Sam discount recorded (good_sam false). Not in a gateway that I know of (Assateague is ~10 miles east; the gateway test is for a human).

Seasonal share (criteria lead): the rates page sells seasonal sites ('SEASONAL CAMPING: We have booked all seasonal sites for the 2025 camping season') and monthly stays ($1,600, up to 3 months); the share of seasonal vs. transient sites is not stated (https://www.islandresort.org/rates/).
